messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Ondansetron can cause a serious heart problem.
This risk is especially high if you use certain medicines at the same time.
These medicines include antibiotics, antidepressants, heart rhythm medicine, antipsychotic medicines, and medicines to treat cancer, malaria, HIV or AIDS.
Tell your doctor about all medicines you use, and those you start or stop using during your treatment with ondansetron.
Taking ondansetron while using certain other medicines can cause high levels of serotonin to build up in your body.
This condition is called "serotonin syndrome."
Serotonin syndrome can be fatal.
Tell your doctor if you also use:
medicine to treat depression;
medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder;
a narcotic (opioid) medication; or
medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting.
This list is not complete and many other drugs can interact with ondansetron.
List includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products.
Give a list of all your medicines to any healthcare provider who treats you.
Triples: [["ondansetron", "has serious side effect", "serious heart problem"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "certain medicines"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "antibiotics"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "antidepressants"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "heart rhythm medicine"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "antipsychotic medicines"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "medicines to treat cancer"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "medicines to treat malaria"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "medicines to treat HIV or AIDS"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor about all medicines you use"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor about medicines you start or stop using during treatment"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "certain other medicines"], ["ondansetron", "has mechanism of action", "causes high levels of serotonin to build up in your body"], ["ondansetron", "has serious side effect", "serotonin syndrome"], ["serotonin syndrome", "has severity", "fatal"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat depression"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to treat a psychiatric disorder"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor if you also use a narcotic (opioid) medication"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "tell your doctor if you also use medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting"], ["ondansetron", "has administration instruction", "give a list of all your medicines to any healthcare provider who treats you"], ["ondansetron", "has warning", "many other drugs can interact with ondansetron"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "prescription medicines"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "over-the-counter medicines"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "vitamins"], ["ondansetron", "interacts with", "herbal products"]]
Relations: ["has administration instruction", "has mechanism of action", "has serious side effect", "has severity", "has warning", "interacts with"]
Answer:

completion:
has administration instruction: The subject drug requires the patient to follow the specific medical instruction specified by the object entity.  
has mechanism of action: The subject drug causes the physiological or pharmacological process specified by the object entity.  
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.  
has severity: The medical condition specified by the subject entity has the level of severity specified by the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug has a caution or warning about the condition specified by the object entity.  
interacts with: The subject drug may have a pharmacological interaction when used with the substance or medication specified by the object entity.
